name: Blue Planet Internet
summary: Early FreeBSD-based dialup + hosting ISP (bluep.com, c. 1996); defunct c. 2001.

events.details: Dialup, hosting, Tucows mirror; earliest Wayback capture Apr 1997 (bluep.com).
Defunct; substantial homepage through 1999, minimal placeholder by 2000-01, redirect from 2006.
BLUE PLANET PTY LTD (ACN 160 489 074) was registered 24 Sep 2012, ~11 years after this ISP was defunct, and is an unrelated later name-collision entity.
